text.en: Pet owners consistently praise Juliana and the grooming team for their welcoming attitude and gentle approach with dogs on Yonge Street. Most reviewers emphasize that the staff treat pets with affection and provide attentive customer service. One owner expressed disappointment over age restrictions when seeking an appointment for an older dog.

Dog owners report that their pets return from grooming looking clean, fluffy, and nicely styled. Clients appreciate the meticulous attention to detail during baths and haircuts, noting that coats smell wonderful and looks remain consistent over repeated visits. The online booking system makes scheduling convenient for regular grooming.

Reviewers note that dogs genuinely enjoy visiting the salon, showing excitement rather than apprehension when arriving for appointments. Owners highlight that groomers handle nervous pets with patience and genuine affection. Multiple clients report trusting the team completely with their pets' comfort and routine hygiene.

q.en: Can dog grooming appointments be booked online?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention using the convenient online booking system to schedule appointments.

q.en: Does AJ Spaw accept walk-in visits for nail trimming?

a.en: Yes, the salon offers walk-in nail trims alongside full grooming packages on Yonge Street.

q.en: Are senior dogs accepted for grooming services?

a.en: Some reviewers report specific age restrictions for older pets, so owners should confirm requirements with the salon before booking.

q.en: What grooming treatments are included in salon visits?

a.en: Packages include full baths, styling haircuts, ear cleaning, and nail maintenance.
